# priogridR

`priogridR` provides a consistent interface for working with PRIO-GRID
data. It combines grid utilities with general converters that transfer
raster, vector, point-event, NetCDF, and geographically indexed tabular
data to a configurable PRIO-GRID.

The package builds on the official
[`priogrid`](https://prio-data.github.io/priogrid/) package for grid
definitions and raster transformations.

## Installation

The package is under active development and is not yet available from
CRAN. Install the development version from GitHub with:

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("christianoswald/priogridR")
```

## Public interface

All user-facing functions begin with `pg_` and use snake case:

- [`pg_from_raster()`](https://christianoswald.github.io/priogridR/reference/pg_from_raster.md)
  converts raster layers.
- [`pg_from_vector()`](https://christianoswald.github.io/priogridR/reference/pg_from_vector.md)
  converts point, line, or polygon features.
- [`pg_from_points()`](https://christianoswald.github.io/priogridR/reference/pg_from_points.md)
  is a convenience wrapper for event or coordinate data.
- [`pg_from_netcdf()`](https://christianoswald.github.io/priogridR/reference/pg_from_netcdf.md)
  converts NetCDF variables and layers.
- [`pg_from_table()`](https://christianoswald.github.io/priogridR/reference/pg_from_table.md)
  transfers geographically indexed tabular data.
- [`pg_create_indices()`](https://christianoswald.github.io/priogridR/reference/pg_create_indices.md)
  creates PRIO-GRID identifier matrices.
- [`pg_neighbors()`](https://christianoswald.github.io/priogridR/reference/pg_neighbors.md)
  returns first-order neighboring cells.
- [`pg_paths()`](https://christianoswald.github.io/priogridR/reference/pg_paths.md)
  constructs reproducible project paths.
- [`pg_theme()`](https://christianoswald.github.io/priogridR/reference/pg_theme.md)
  supplies a map-oriented ggplot2 theme.
- [`pg_write_result()`](https://christianoswald.github.io/priogridR/reference/pg_write_result.md)
  writes conversion outputs.

## Example

``` r

library(priogridR)

pg_create_indices(nrow = 3, ncol = 3)
pg_neighbors(5, nrow = 3, ncol = 3)
```

Point-event data can be aggregated using the temporal and spatial
settings in a PRIO-GRID configuration:

``` r

events <- data.frame(
  longitude = c(10, 10.1, 20),
  latitude = c(50, 50.1, 60),
  event_date = as.Date(c("2020-01-01", "2020-03-01", "2021-06-01"))
)

config <- priogrid::pg_config(
  temporal_resolution = "1 year",
  start_date = as.Date("2020-12-31"),
  end_date = as.Date("2021-12-31")
)

event_counts <- pg_from_points(
  x = events,
  variable = "event_count",
  longitude = "longitude",
  latitude = "latitude",
  aggregation = "count",
  time_column = "event_date",
  config = config
)
```

See
[`vignette("getting-started", package = "priogridR")`](https://christianoswald.github.io/priogridR/articles/getting-started.md)
and
[`vignette("conversion-workflows", package = "priogridR")`](https://christianoswald.github.io/priogridR/articles/conversion-workflows.md)
for an introduction and a guide to choosing a converter. The package
website also provides a focused article for every `pg_from_*()`
function.

# Package index

## Convert data to PRIO-GRID

- [`pg_from_netcdf()`](https://christianoswald.github.io/priogridR/reference/pg_from_netcdf.md)
  : Convert NetCDF data to PRIO-GRID
- [`pg_from_points()`](https://christianoswald.github.io/priogridR/reference/pg_from_points.md)
  : Convert point or event data to PRIO-GRID
- [`pg_from_raster()`](https://christianoswald.github.io/priogridR/reference/pg_from_raster.md)
  : Convert raster data to PRIO-GRID
- [`pg_from_table()`](https://christianoswald.github.io/priogridR/reference/pg_from_table.md)
  : Transfer geographically indexed table data to PRIO-GRID
- [`pg_from_vector()`](https://christianoswald.github.io/priogridR/reference/pg_from_vector.md)
  : Convert vector data to PRIO-GRID

## Grid utilities

- [`pg_create_indices()`](https://christianoswald.github.io/priogridR/reference/pg_create_indices.md)
  : Create a matrix of PRIO-GRID identifiers
- [`pg_neighbors()`](https://christianoswald.github.io/priogridR/reference/pg_neighbors.md)
  : Find first-order PRIO-GRID neighbors
- [`pg_paths()`](https://christianoswald.github.io/priogridR/reference/pg_paths.md)
  : Construct standard project data paths
- [`pg_theme()`](https://christianoswald.github.io/priogridR/reference/pg_theme.md)
  : A theme for plotting PRIO-GRID data

## Results and output

- [`pg_write_result()`](https://christianoswald.github.io/priogridR/reference/pg_write_result.md)
  : Write a PRIO-GRID conversion result
- [`print(`*`<pg_result>`*`)`](https://christianoswald.github.io/priogridR/reference/print.pg_result.md)
  : Print a PRIO-GRID conversion result
- [`as.data.frame(`*`<pg_result>`*`)`](https://christianoswald.github.io/priogridR/reference/as.data.frame.pg_result.md)
  : Convert a PRIO-GRID result to a data frame

## Data

- [`priogrid`](https://christianoswald.github.io/priogridR/reference/priogrid.md)
  : PRIO-GRID information

# Articles

### Start here

- [Getting started with
  priogridR](https://christianoswald.github.io/priogridR/articles/getting-started.md):

  Learn the core grid utilities, return types, output helpers, and
  plotting conventions in priogridR.

- [Choosing a PRIO-GRID conversion
  workflow](https://christianoswald.github.io/priogridR/articles/conversion-workflows.md):

  Choose the appropriate priogridR converter for raster, vector,
  point-event, NetCDF, or geographically indexed tabular data.

### Conversion guides

Detailed workflows for each supported source-data format.

- [Converting point and event
  data](https://christianoswald.github.io/priogridR/articles/pg_from_points.md):

  Aggregate coordinates and point events to PRIO-GRID cells, including
  values, dates, groups, and structural zeros.

- [Converting raster
  data](https://christianoswald.github.io/priogridR/articles/pg_from_raster.md):

  Align static and time-varying rasters to PRIO-GRID and choose suitable
  aggregation, disaggregation, and output options.

- [Converting vector
  data](https://christianoswald.github.io/priogridR/articles/pg_from_vector.md):

  Aggregate point, line, and polygon geometries to PRIO-GRID using
  counts, lengths, areas, coverage, and weighted values.

- [Converting NetCDF
  data](https://christianoswald.github.io/priogridR/articles/pg_from_netcdf.md):

  Select NetCDF variables and layers, handle time and missing values,
  and convert them to PRIO-GRID.

- [Converting geographically indexed
  tables](https://christianoswald.github.io/priogridR/articles/pg_from_table.md):

  Join tabular observations to polygon geographies and transfer totals,
  rates, or constant values to PRIO-GRID cells.
